title: QA_Platform_dboq_boq_flag_with_real_line_items_still_refused_when_boq_is_off
preconditions: boq_in_erfx_allowed is OFF for this workspace (Company#boq_in_erfx_allowed? is false: the switch is not set or no active BOQ template exists). A product and variant from the catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups as a draft with config.boq_based_rfx true AND one valid catalog line item.
2. Expect 422 code 101; no event group is created.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action' — the BOQ gate (render_error_json(101) unless Current.workspace.boq_in_erfx_allowed?) runs before the line-item check, so sending real line items does not get a BOQ project past it (app/controllers/api/event_groups_controller.rb:28-30). No event_groups row is written.
rationale: The UI only offers 'BOQ based RFX Project' when the flag is on; a hand-made request with line items must not slip a BOQ project into a workspace that has not bought it.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_empty_string_boq_flag_is_read_as_boq_on
preconditions: boq_in_erfx_allowed is OFF for this workspace (Company#boq_in_erfx_allowed? is false: the switch is not set or no active BOQ template exists).
steps: 1. POST /event_groups as a draft with config.boq_based_rfx "" (empty string) and no line_items.
2. Expect a 4xx (101 today), never a 2xx and never a 5xx.
expectedResult: HTTP 422. Today: code 101 "You are not allowed to perform this action" — params.dig("config","boq_based_rfx") || false keeps "" (an empty string is truthy in Ruby), so the request is treated as a BOQ create and hits the gate (event_groups_controller.rb:28-30). If the flag were coerced to a boolean the answer would be code 2 "Insufficient parameters" (no line items, :31-32). Either 4xx is acceptable; nothing is created.
rationale: Documents the truthiness coercion of the BOQ flag: an empty value is not 'off'.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_empty_object_boq_flag_is_read_as_boq_on
preconditions: boq_in_erfx_allowed is OFF for this workspace (Company#boq_in_erfx_allowed? is false: the switch is not set or no active BOQ template exists).
steps: 1. POST /event_groups as a draft with config.boq_based_rfx {} (an empty JSON object) and no line_items.
2. Expect a 4xx, never a 2xx and never a 5xx.
expectedResult: HTTP 422. Today code 101 — an empty Parameters object is truthy, so the BOQ gate answers (event_groups_controller.rb:28-30); with a boolean coercion it would be code 2 (no line items). Nothing is created.
rationale: Wrong-type flag values must never be stored as a half-BOQ project.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_null_boq_flag_without_line_items_is_insufficient_parameters
preconditions: A buyer session on the company under test (any boq_in_erfx_allowed state).
steps: 1. POST /event_groups as a draft with config.boq_based_rfx null and no line_items.
2. Expect 422 code 2.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' — nil || false makes it an ordinary create, and an ordinary create needs line items (event_groups_controller.rb:28-32). Nothing is created.
rationale: Only a BOQ project may start empty; a null flag must not open that door.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_false_boq_flag_without_line_items_is_insufficient_parameters
preconditions: A buyer session on the company under test (any boq_in_erfx_allowed state).
steps: 1. POST /event_groups as a draft with config.boq_based_rfx false and no line_items.
2. Expect 422 code 2.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' — boq_based_rfx false is an ordinary create and line_items is blank (event_groups_controller.rb:28-32). Nothing is created.
rationale: Explicit 'not BOQ' must keep the line-items requirement.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_boq_project_with_null_line_items_starts_empty
preconditions: boq_in_erfx_allowed is ON for this workspace (Company#boq_in_erfx_allowed? is true: the switch is set and the company has an active BOQ template, type t-boq).
steps: 1. POST /event_groups as a draft with config.boq_based_rfx true and line_items null.
2. Expect 200: a draft BOQ project with no line items (event_group_line_item_ids empty).
expectedResult: HTTP 200 — a blank line_items on a BOQ create becomes [] (event_groups_controller.rb:37-41) and CreateService#create_line_items returns [] early for a BOQ project (app/services/event_groups/create_service.rb:48-50). The reply"s config.boq_based_rfx is true and it lists no line items.
rationale: This is exactly what the dashboard sends when the buyer opens a BOQ project (projectCreation.jsx:3085-3093): the BOQ lines arrive later from the sheet upload.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_boq_project_with_empty_string_line_items_starts_empty
preconditions: boq_in_erfx_allowed is ON for this workspace (Company#boq_in_erfx_allowed? is true: the switch is set and the company has an active BOQ template, type t-boq).
steps: 1. POST /event_groups as a draft with config.boq_based_rfx true and line_items "".
2. Expect 200 with no line items.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 — "" is blank, so line_items becomes [] (event_groups_controller.rb:37-41; create_service.rb:48-50). No line items are created.
rationale: An empty string must behave like 'no lines yet', not crash the typed CreateService (line_items: T::Array[Hash]).

title: QA_Platform_dboq_boq_project_seeded_with_one_catalog_line_gets_serial_1
preconditions: boq_in_erfx_allowed is ON for this workspace (Company#boq_in_erfx_allowed? is true: the switch is set and the company has an active BOQ template, type t-boq). A product and variant from the catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups as a draft with config.boq_based_rfx true and one catalog line item (quantity 10 Nos).
2. Expect 200 with exactly one event_group_line_item id; the line's serial number is 1.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 — a BOQ create that does carry lines goes through the same get_details_for_event_group_line_items path as an ordinary event (trade_controller_helper.rb:6290-6334) and each line gets serial_number index+1 (create_service.rb:52-60). Reply: config.boq_based_rfx true, one line item id.
rationale: BOQ projects created from a PR or a clone arrive with lines; the BOQ flag must not drop them.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_boq_project_with_two_lines_numbers_them_1_and_2
preconditions: boq_in_erfx_allowed is ON for this workspace (Company#boq_in_erfx_allowed? is true: the switch is set and the company has an active BOQ template, type t-boq). A product and variant from the catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups as a draft with config.boq_based_rfx true and two line items for the same product (10 and 20 Nos).
2. Expect 200 with two line item ids, serial numbers 1 and 2 in request order.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with two ids — serial_number = index + 1 in request order (create_service.rb:52-60); the same product twice is allowed (BOQ lines are free text in practice).
rationale: Serial numbers are what the BOQ grid shows next to each line; a regression that reorders them breaks every vendor's quote mapping.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_zero_quantity_boq_line_is_kept_as_rate_only
preconditions: boq_in_erfx_allowed is ON for this workspace (Company#boq_in_erfx_allowed? is true: the switch is set and the company has an active BOQ template, type t-boq). A product and variant from the catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups as a draft with config.boq_based_rfx true and one line item with quantity value 0.
2. Expect 200; the stored line is rate-only.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 — quantity 0 is not refused; the line is stored with is_rate_only true (trade_controller_helper.rb:6319-6321). Rate-only lines then add 0 to tab totals and 0 to the loading factor.
rationale: BOQs routinely carry 'rate only' items (provisional sums); refusing or silently dropping them would break the sheet.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_exactly_500_boq_lines_the_default_cap_are_accepted
preconditions: boq_in_erfx_allowed is ON for this workspace (Company#boq_in_erfx_allowed? is true: the switch is set and the company has an active BOQ template, type t-boq). allowed_maximum_line_items is the default {boq: 500, non_boq: 65}. A product and variant from the catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups as a draft with config.boq_based_rfx true and 500 catalog line items (quantities 1..500).
2. Expect 200 with 500 line item ids, serial numbers 1..500.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with 500 ids — the server enforces no line cap at all (allowed_maximum_line_items is only read for the dashboard, app/controllers/api/v1/users_controller.rb:593,732); the lines are bulk-imported in one statement (EventGroupLineItem.import, create_service.rb:62). Must answer well inside the request timeout.
rationale: Exactly at the default BOQ cap (db/migrate/20250305075906_add_custom_maximum_line_items_allowed_config.rb). #15339 made this size performant; a slow or failed create here is a performance regression.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_66_lines_on_an_ordinary_create_are_not_capped_by_the_server
preconditions: A buyer session on the company under test; the dashboard's non-BOQ line limit is the default 65. A product and variant from the catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups as an ordinary draft (no BOQ flag) with 66 catalog line items — one over the dashboard's non-BOQ limit.
2. Expect no 5xx. Today: 200 with 66 line item ids (the limit lives only in the dashboard).
expectedResult: No 5xx. Today HTTP 200 with 66 ids: the 65-line limit is checked only in the dashboard (src/redux/user/selectors.js:346-360, src/views/projectCreation/helpers.js:369-374); event_groups_controller#create has no count check. A 4xx would mean a server cap was added.
rationale: Records that the line cap is a UI rule: anything that bypasses the dashboard (API, integrations, PR conversion) can exceed it.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_empty_object_boq_flag_is_stored_as_a_truthy_non_boolean
preconditions: boq_in_erfx_allowed is ON for this workspace (Company#boq_in_erfx_allowed? is true: the switch is set and the company has an active BOQ template, type t-boq).
steps: 1. POST /event_groups as a draft with config.boq_based_rfx {} and no line_items.
2. Expect no 5xx. Today: 200 — a project whose boq_based_rfx is the object {}, which every later check treats as BOQ.
expectedResult: No 5xx. Today HTTP 200: {} is truthy at event_groups_controller.rb:28, the raw config is stored as sent (create_service.rb:40) and EventGroup#boq_based_rfx? returns {} (app/models/event_group.rb:936-938) — the dashboard reads it as a JS object (truthy) too.
rationale: A non-boolean flag stored in config is read differently by every consumer; it should be coerced or refused.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_deleting_the_only_line_item_of_a_live_event_is_refused
preconditions: The sandbox event {{eventGroupUuid}}: published (active), one pricing stage with an open window, exactly ONE active line item {{lineItemUuid}}, no bids, no proposals; the caller is its buyer.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with line_items [{uuid: {{lineItemUuid}}, status: "deleted"}].
2. Expect 422 code 711; the line item is still active (GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}/get_line_items count 1).
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 711 'You cannot delete this line item from the project' — one row in the request and one active line on the event trips the guard (app/services/event_groups/update_service.rb:174-175) before anything is deleted; the transaction rolls back (event_group_controller_helper.rb:28-36).
rationale: An event without line items cannot be bid on or awarded. If the guard ever fails this case deletes the sandbox's only line — run it after the read cases.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_deleting_a_line_item_that_does_not_exist_is_answered_as_711
preconditions: The sandbox event {{eventGroupUuid}}: published (active), one pricing stage with an open window, exactly ONE active line item {{lineItemUuid}}, no bids, no proposals; the caller is its buyer.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with line_items [{uuid: "WrongUuid1=", status: "deleted"}].
2. Expect 422 code 711 (not a 'not found'), and nothing changes.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 711 'You cannot delete this line item from the project' — the guard compares the NUMBER of request rows (1) with the number of active lines (1) and never checks that the row names a line of this event (update_service.rb:172-175); the undecodable uuid becomes id nil (params_auth.rb:66-71).
rationale: Shows the guard is about counts, not identity — the root of the bypass in API-XDBOQ-029 and the IDOR in API-XDBOQ-030/031.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_line_items_sent_as_plain_text_on_patch_is_a_4xx_not_a_crash
preconditions: The sandbox event {{eventGroupUuid}}: published (active), one pricing stage with an open window, exactly ONE active line item {{lineItemUuid}}, no bids, no proposals; the caller is its buyer.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with line_items set to a plain string.
2. Expect a 4xx; nothing changes. Today the update service calls .select on the string (500).
expectedResult: Must not 5xx. Today: params[:line_items].present? sends the string into UpdateService#execute, and create_line_items calls @line_items.select (app/services/event_groups/update_service.rb:97) → NoMethodError → HTTP 500. Expected: 422 code 2. The transaction rolls back, so the sandbox is unchanged.
rationale: The BOQ re-upload and line edits both go through this request; malformed input must be refused, not crash.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_a_patch_line_item_with_an_unknown_product_is_a_4xx_not_a_crash
preconditions: The sandbox event {{eventGroupUuid}}: published (active), one pricing stage with an open window, exactly ONE active line item {{lineItemUuid}}, no bids, no proposals; the caller is its buyer. A variant uuid from the catalog.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with one new line item whose product_uuid decodes to a non-existent product (Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==).
2. Expect a 4xx (80 'Product not found' or 2); nothing is added. Today: 500.
expectedResult: Must not 5xx. Today: get_details_for_event_group_line_items looks the product up among active products, gets nil and calls product.id (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:6298-6300) → NoMethodError → HTTP 500; the transaction rolls back.
rationale: A deactivated product on a re-uploaded or edited sheet would take down the whole save instead of naming the bad row.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_a_patch_line_item_that_is_an_empty_object_is_a_4xx_not_a_crash
preconditions: The sandbox event {{eventGroupUuid}}: published (active), one pricing stage with an open window, exactly ONE active line item {{lineItemUuid}}, no bids, no proposals; the caller is its buyer.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with line_items [{}].
2. Expect a 4xx; nothing changes. Today: 500.
expectedResult: Must not 5xx. Today: the empty row has no status (so it is not a deletion), no product_id, and product.id is called on nil (trade_controller_helper.rb:6298-6300) → HTTP 500.
rationale: Empty rows are what a spreadsheet with trailing blank lines produces.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_linking_a_purchase_request_that_does_not_exist_is_refused
preconditions: The sandbox event {{eventGroupUuid}}: published (active), one pricing stage with an open window, exactly ONE active line item {{lineItemUuid}}, no bids, no proposals; the caller is its buyer.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with purchase_request_uuid Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== (decodes to id 999999999).
2. Expect 422 code 101; nothing is linked.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action' — the uuid is decoded to purchase_request_id (params_auth.rb:66-71) and looked up in PurchaseRequest.active.boq of this workspace (app/controllers/concerns/event_group_controller_helper.rb:2579-2590), before authorize. No mapping is created.
rationale: Only an active BOQ PR of this workspace may feed a BOQ project.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_an_undecodable_purchase_request_uuid_is_silently_ignored
preconditions: The sandbox event {{eventGroupUuid}}: published (active), one pricing stage with an open window, exactly ONE active line item {{lineItemUuid}}, no bids, no proposals; the caller is its buyer.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with purchase_request_uuid "WrongUuid1=" and nothing else.
2. Expect no 5xx. Today: 200 and no change — the bad id is dropped instead of refused.
expectedResult: No 5xx. Today HTTP 200: WrongUuid1= decodes to nil, params[:purchase_request_id].present? is false so the PR check is skipped (event_group_controller_helper.rb:2584), and with no status/line_items/config nothing is updated (event_group_controller_helper.rb:28-36). Expected ideally: 422, since the client asked for a link that was not made.
rationale: A dashboard that believes the PR got linked will show wrong PR quantities; a silent 200 hides that.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_a_non_numeric_purchase_request_id_is_refused
preconditions: The sandbox event {{eventGroupUuid}}: published (active), one pricing stage with an open window, exactly ONE active line item {{lineItemUuid}}, no bids, no proposals; the caller is its buyer.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with purchase_request_id "abc".
2. Expect 422 code 101.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action' — "abc" is present, the integer cast matches no row of PurchaseRequest.active.boq (event_group_controller_helper.rb:2584-2587).
rationale: Raw ids bypass ParamsAuth decoding; they must still be scoped and validated.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_linking_the_workspaces_first_purchase_request_is_refused_unless_it_is_a_boq_pr
preconditions: The sandbox event {{eventGroupUuid}}: published (active), one pricing stage with an open window, exactly ONE active line item {{lineItemUuid}}, no bids, no proposals; the caller is its buyer. {{prId}} is the client's first purchase request (REAL record; usually a material PR). The request writes nothing to it.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with purchase_request_uuid {{prId}} and nothing else.
2. Expect no 5xx: 422 code 101 when that PR is not an active BOQ PR; 200 with no change when it is (the sandbox is not a BOQ project, so no mapping is made).
expectedResult: No 5xx. A material/service PR → 422 code 101 "You are not allowed to perform this action" (PurchaseRequest.active.boq scope, event_group_controller_helper.rb:2585). A BOQ PR → 200 and map_purchase_request_to_event_group skips the mapping because the sandbox is not boq_based_rfx (event_group_controller_helper.rb:2640-2641).
rationale: Linking a material PR to a BOQ project would double-count PR quantities.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_listing_boq_templates_returns_default_and_saved
preconditions: A buyer session on the company under test.
steps: 1. GET /templates?type_identifier=boq&hide_onboarding_v2_templates=true (what the BOQ template picker sends).
2. Expect 200 with {default: [...], saved: [...]} (either may be empty).
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with default and saved arrays filtered to type t-boq (app/controllers/api/templates_controller.rb:107-143; app/helpers/templates_helper.rb:4-50). When boq_in_erfx_allowed is ON, at least one active BOQ template exists for the company (company.rb:1096-1103), though "saved" only lists the ones this user may see.
rationale: This is the list the dashboard's BOQ project template picker shows (templateSelection.jsx:444-446).

title: QA_Platform_dboq_the_internal_t_boq_identifier_is_not_accepted_as_a_filter
preconditions: A buyer session on the company under test.
steps: 1. GET /templates?type_identifier=t-boq.
2. Expect 422 code 2.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' — type_identifier must be a plain name from Template::TEMPLATE_FOR_TYPES (templates_controller.rb:118-120; app/models/template.rb:58-61); the stored form 't-boq' is not one.
rationale: Clients mixing the stored and the public identifier get a clear refusal instead of an empty list.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_an_upper_case_boq_type_is_refused
preconditions: A buyer session on the company under test.
steps: 1. GET /templates?type_identifier=BOQ.
2. Expect 422 code 2.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' — the membership test is case-sensitive (templates_controller.rb:119).
rationale: Guards the exact-match contract the dashboard relies on.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_a_plain_text_exclude_list_is_a_4xx_not_a_json_crash
preconditions: A buyer session on the company under test.
steps: 1. GET /templates?type_identifier=trade&exclude_type_identifiers=boq (plain text, not JSON).
2. Expect a 4xx. Today: JSON.parse raises and the server answers 500.
expectedResult: Must not 5xx. Today: a String exclude_type_identifiers is passed straight to JSON.parse (templates_controller.rb:113-115); "boq" is not JSON, JSON::ParserError is not rescued anywhere in the API controllers → HTTP 500. Expected: 422 code 2.
rationale: The eRFX template picker excludes BOQ templates from ordinary projects (templateSelection.jsx:126-131); any client that sends the list un-encoded crashes the picker.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_excluding_boq_while_asking_for_boq_returns_empty_lists
preconditions: A buyer session on the company under test.
steps: 1. GET /templates?type_identifier=boq&exclude_type_identifiers=["boq"].
2. Expect 200 with default [] and saved [].
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with both lists empty — every t-boq template is filtered back out by filter_out_exclude_type_identifier (templates_helper.rb:52-57).
rationale: Contradictory filters must give an empty, well-formed answer.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_excluding_the_internal_t_boq_identifier_is_refused
preconditions: A buyer session on the company under test.
steps: 1. GET /templates?type_identifier=boq&exclude_type_identifiers=["t-boq"].
2. Expect 422 code 2.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' — every exclude entry must be in Template::TEMPLATE_FOR_TYPES (templates_controller.rb:121-123).
rationale: Same contract as API-XDBOQ-043, on the exclude list.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_an_exclude_list_sent_as_an_object_is_refused
preconditions: A buyer session on the company under test.
steps: 1. GET /templates?type_identifier=boq&exclude_type_identifiers={"boq":1}.
2. Expect 422 code 2.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' — Array({"boq"=>1}) is [["boq",1]], which is not a type name (templates_controller.rb:116,121-123).
rationale: Wrong JSON shapes must be refused, not half-applied.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_downloading_the_boq_sheet_of_a_template_that_does_not_exist_is_refused
preconditions: A buyer session on the company under test.
steps: 1. GET /templates/excel_template/Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==?sheet_type=boq_items_sheet (id 999999999, no such template).
2. Expect 422 code 4.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 4 'Request not found' — Template.get_authorized_template_with_id finds no active template (app/models/template.rb:117-121), called from templates_controller.rb:177-179 before any sheet is built.
rationale: The 'Download Template' button in the BOQ upload modal (uploadExcelModal.jsx:139-147) must fail cleanly for a deleted template.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_downloading_the_boq_sheet_with_an_undecodable_template_id_is_refused
preconditions: A buyer session on the company under test.
steps: 1. GET /templates/excel_template/WrongUuid1=?sheet_type=boq_items_sheet.
2. Expect 422 code 4.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 4 'Request not found' — the id decodes to nil (params_auth.rb:57-62) and a blank id is refused first (app/models/template.rb:118-120).
rationale: Undecodable ids must not reach the Excel builder.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_uploading_a_boq_sheet_without_the_file_is_refused
preconditions: A buyer session on the company under test. NOT on the default allowlist — the request is refused on its first line, before the template lookup, the upload log or any parsing.
steps: 1. POST /templates/product_sheet_params with template_uuid, excel_type multistage and sheet_type boq_items_sheet, but no excel_data.
2. Expect 422 code 2; nothing is parsed or stored.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' — render_error_json(2) if excel_data.nil? is the first statement of product_sheet_params (app/controllers/api/templates_controller.rb:215-217).
rationale: This is the BOQ 'Upload Sheet' call (src/redux/orders/actions.js:2049-2066); a missing file must be refused before the BOQ parser creates units or free-text products.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_uploading_a_boq_sheet_against_a_template_that_does_not_exist_is_refused
preconditions: A buyer session on the company under test. NOT on the default allowlist — refused at the template lookup, before save_upload_excel_log and before any parsing or master-data insert.
steps: 1. POST /templates/product_sheet_params with a tiny base64 excel_data and template_uuid Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== (no such template).
2. Expect 422 code 4; no upload log, no parsing.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 4 'Request not found' — fetch_template_by_id → Template.get_authorized_template_with_id returns 4 for a missing template (templates_controller.rb:219-220; app/models/template.rb:117-121), before save_upload_excel_log (:229).
rationale: A stale template id in the BOQ upload must not reach the parser.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_reading_the_line_items_of_a_project_that_does_not_exist_is_refused
preconditions: A buyer session on the company under test.
steps: 1. GET /event_groups/Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==/get_line_items.
2. Expect 422 code 533.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 533 'Project does not exist.' — get_line_items looks the event up by status and id before authorize (app/controllers/api/event_groups_controller.rb:466-471).
rationale: The line-item read is the oracle for every BOQ upload/replace case; it must fail cleanly on a bad id.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_a_negative_page_on_the_line_items_read_is_clamped_to_page_1
preconditions: The sandbox event {{eventGroupUuid}} (one line item).
steps: 1. GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}/get_line_items?page=-3.
2. Expect 200 with page 1: the sandbox's one line item, total_pages 1.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 — paginate clamps with [1, page.to_i].max (event_groups_controller.rb:1703-1705), so -3 reads page 1; count 1, total_pages 1. (If hide_line_items_from_project_details_vendor_side is on the reply is {} for everyone — :472-473.)
rationale: Large BOQ projects are paged; a bad page number must not error or return someone else's slice.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_a_search_filter_that_is_a_json_list_is_a_4xx_not_a_crash
preconditions: The sandbox event {{eventGroupUuid}}.
steps: 1. GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}/get_line_items?search=[1] (valid JSON, but a list).
2. Expect 200 (ignored) or a 4xx. Today: 500.
expectedResult: Must not 5xx. Today: with no "filters", create_filter_params sets @filters = JSON.parse(search) = [1] (event_groups_controller.rb:1603-1604), and get_filtered_eglis does @filters["category_ids"] on an Array (:1551) → TypeError → HTTP 500.
rationale: Search on the project's line-item list is user-typed; its JSON shape must be validated.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_malformed_filters_and_search_together_are_a_4xx_not_a_crash
preconditions: The sandbox event {{eventGroupUuid}}.
steps: 1. GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}/get_line_items?filters=notjson&search=notjson.
2. Expect 200 (filters ignored) or a 4xx. Today: 500.
expectedResult: Must not 5xx. Today: CommonFunctions.parse_filters swallows the bad "filters" and returns nil (lib/common_functions.rb:83-96), the else-branch JSON.parse(search) raises and is rescued (event_groups_controller.rb:1603-1608), leaving @filters nil; get_filtered_eglis then calls nil["category_ids"] (:1551) → NoMethodError → HTTP 500.
rationale: The rescue in create_filter_params hides the parse error but leaves the request in a state that crashes later.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_the_tab_summary_of_an_ordinary_stage_is_refused
preconditions: The sandbox stage {{tradeId}} (an ordinary RFQ stage, no tabs). NOT on the default allowlist (two path segments after the id) — a read.
steps: 1. GET /v1/trade/{{tradeId}}/quote_summary/Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==.
2. Expect 422 code 101.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action' — quote_summary serves BOQ tab totals only; after validate_event it answers 101 when trade.tabs is blank (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:806-813).
rationale: Confirms the BOQ-only endpoint refuses ordinary stages instead of computing empty or wrong totals.
notRunnable: the web console app is not enabled for this action (config/app_auth_config.yml → client_admin_dashboard has no "quote_summary"), so the buyer's console session gets 401 "This app is not authorized to use this API" — and every 401 marks that session logged out (json_helpers.rb check_session_validity), which would end the run for every case after it. It needs the app this endpoint is enabled for (the vendor/mobile client).

title: QA_Platform_dboq_asking_for_a_tab_page_on_an_ordinary_stage_is_a_4xx_not_a_crash
preconditions: The sandbox stage {{tradeId}} (an ordinary RFQ stage: misc.tabs is empty). NOT on the default allowlist (two path segments after the id) — a read.
steps: 1. GET /v1/trade/{{tradeId}}/quote_details/Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==?tab=1&page=1.
2. Expect a 4xx (4 for the missing quote, or the tab params ignored). Today: 500.
expectedResult: Must not 5xx. Today: quote_details calls set_pagination_for_line_items before looking the quote up (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:643-651); with no tabs, trade.tabs[1] || trade.tabs.first is nil and nil["range"] raises (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:6337-6342) → HTTP 500. The event-group twin of this helper has "return if tabs.blank?" (event_group_controller_helper.rb:208-209); this one does not.
rationale: The dashboard sends tab&page whenever it pages a sheet (src/redux/orders/api.js:78-87); a stage that loses its tabs, or a client that sends them for every stage, crashes the quote view.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_a_line_range_filter_with_a_text_bound_is_a_4xx_not_a_crash
preconditions: The sandbox stage {{tradeId}}.
steps: 1. GET /trade/{{tradeId}}?filters={"range":{"from":"a","to":1}}.
2. Expect 200 (range ignored) or a 4xx, never a 5xx.
expectedResult: Must not 5xx. The "range" filter is the BOQ tab window; it is taken from client filters unchecked and used as @filters["range"]["from"]..@filters["range"]["to"] (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:668). A Range of "a"..1 raises ArgumentError when the sheet data path is taken → HTTP 500.
rationale: Client-supplied ranges should be validated as integers; today they reach Ruby's Range constructor raw.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_boq_project_defaults_force_lot_based_evaluation_even_for_the_string_false
preconditions: A buyer session with trade create permission. NOT on the default allowlist (GET /v1/trade/<x> with no segment) — a read.
steps: 1. GET /v1/trade/new_request_config?filters={"for_boq_based_project":"false"}.
2. Expect 200. Today the defaults come back with rfp_evaluation_mode lot_based, as for a BOQ project.
expectedResult: HTTP 200. Observation: for_boq_based_project is read with plain truthiness (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:132-152 → get_default_trade_configs, trade_controller_helper.rb:5576-5578), so the STRING "false" still forces default_rfp_evaluation_mode "lot_based". Compare with the same call without the filter (workspace default).
rationale: The dashboard sends this filter for BOQ projects (src/redux/orders/actions.js:424-425); a client that sends 'false' gets BOQ defaults.

title: QA_Platform_dboq_uploading_a_bid_sheet_for_a_stage_that_does_not_exist_is_refused
preconditions: A buyer session on the company under test. NOT on the default allowlist — refused at the active-stage lookup, before the S3 upload and the Report row.
steps: 1. POST /v1/trade/Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==/upload_bid_excel with a tiny base64 excel_data and excel_type bid.
2. Expect 422 code 4; no Report row, no S3 object.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 4 'Request not found' — TradeRequest.active.find_by_id finds nothing (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1065-1069), before authorize, the S3 upload and Report.save! (:1071-1073).
rationale: Bid-sheet upload is how BOQ bids are filled (addBidDrawer.jsx:600-603); a stale stage id must be refused before anything is stored.
